Author: Local
Name: DualSense Lighting
Description: Custom USB DualSense lighting with a live preview. Includes an opt-in combat SFX loudness-sync prototype, RGB animations and independent white player indicators. Custom lights turn off and controller handles close automatically when FFXIV loses focus, so other lighting apps can take over. Background game lighting is always guarded. Native haptics, speaker and triggers pass through.
Punchline: Custom DualSense lighting with protection for other apps.
